tools.name: omniprovider_list_models
tools.description: Returns the public catalog: model ids, context windows, maximum output tokens, price per million input and output tokens, accepted payment rails and prepaid packs that can be bought now.

tools.name: omniprovider_get_pricing
tools.description: Returns prices: fixed per-call prices of the nano, small and brief routes, and per-token prices of the catalog. With a model and token counts it also returns an estimated cost and the minimum charge per rail.

tools.name: omniprovider_get_quote
tools.description: Sends one unpaid request to a paid route and returns the 402 payment requirements (amount, currency, network, payee, protocol). No payment is made and no credential is sent; the response is the quote for that exact request body.

tools.name: omniprovider_how_to_pay
tools.description: Returns the payment flow for a rail: endpoint URL, required headers, the client nonce format, and client commands. Payment is produced by the caller's own wallet tooling; this server holds no keys.
